notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Added features
[list]
[*] Control Settings; There is now a slider for adjusting the in-game camera sensitivity.
[/list]

Changes
[list]
[*] Guard behaviour has been tweaked slightly so stationary ones have proper interactions.
[*] The doors leading to room 3 and room 4 have been swapped around!
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where rolling guard heads onto pressure plates would not show them on the pressure plate.
[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
Added features:
[list]
[*] Sound Settings; The sound settings in the settings menu are now functional.
[*] Room 4; We've added an entire new room with a new collectible to collect.
[*] Achievements; Added achievements for room 4 and getting to the ending cutscene.
[/list]

Balancing:
[list]
[*] Lowered the hearing range of guards.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could not pick up a guard head anymore if the guard stole back the head in the middle of a player animation.
[*] Fixed height of trees in the hub world.
[*] Vents have been made less troublesome by guiding the player into the vent when entering one.
[/list]
